title: Leveling Craft
description: LevelingCraft: Summon and level AI ally mobs that fight for players, managed via GUI and commands (/summon, /despawn, /allies).
body:
# LEVELING CRAFT

LevelingCraft is an immersive RPG-style companion and progression plugin designed to transform the way players experience survival or adventure servers. The core idea revolves around players being able to summon unique “ally mobs” that follow them, protect them, and help them in battles. These allies are controlled through intuitive commands such as /summon, /despawn, and /allies, while the plugin manages all progression data internally through PlayerData systems. Each ally can level up, grow stronger, and develop into a valuable combat partner as the player explores the world. A well-structured GUI system ensures that players can easily view ally information, manage their companions, and interact with upgrade menus without needing prior knowledge or complex instructions. LevelingCraft adds depth to combat encounters, enhances PvE challenges, and gives servers a dynamic RPG feel without overwhelming players. Server owners who want to enrich their gameplay with companion mechanics, progression systems, and AI-backed mob support will find this plugin especially useful.
